claim: Vera holds the deepest loop a thirty-year companion must hold — the one that turns a good memory into genuine LEARNING, and does it as REASONING, not scorekeeping: observation -> grounded HYPOTHESIS(es, COMPETING) -> PREDICTION -> OUTCOME -> SURPRISE -> LEARNING -> MODEL REVISION. From a real recorded turn that states a destabilising change she forms a SET of competing, evidence-anchored hypotheses (each carrying the exact turn it rests on), the leading one yields a time-horizoned prediction, and when a LATER recorded turn delivers the outcome she logs that prediction against it, computes the SURPRISE (high when confident-and-wrong or doubtful-and-right), ADJUDICATES the competition (the supported hypothesis strengthened, the contradicted ones weakened, weights renormalised), records an append-only LEARNING, and — on a high-surprise outcome — a MODEL REVISION. calibrate() then measures, per category, which prediction kinds she gets right. By LAW this ledger is INTERNAL model-state and OBSERVE-ONLY: it never asserts a prediction or a diagnosis to the user, never touches the live reply (mouth/server/route), and every human-readable line passes the same no-diagnosis clean-gate. It is GROUNDED (a thin/mood-only turn forms NOTHING — no confabulation) and TIME-GATED (real calibration accrues over real calendar time; the machinery is proven on a synthetic time-series).
owner: anima/reality.py (form = derive grounded competing HYPOTHESES + a COMPETITION + a leading-hypothesis PREDICTION from a recorded turn; resolve = match a later recorded OUTCOME, compute SURPRISE, ADJUDICATE the competition, append OUTCOME+LEARNING+ a high-surprise REVISION; surprise = |actual - predicted_confidence|; calibrate = per-category accuracy/Brier/mean-surprise/reliability; competition_for = revision-rolled weights; loop/render = the append-only audit view, every line clean-gated; the per-creature append-only ledger .anima/{name}.reality.jsonl), scripts/reality.py (the VERA REALITY OBSERVATORY — reads the ledger and renders the loop + the calibration dashboard, strictly read-only; has --selftest/--json/--real)

killer_test.name: epistemic_loop_closes_prediction_logged_against_outcome_yields_learning
killer_test.setup: Hermetic temp store (reality.STORE redirected here; world_state/meaning/memory_lirf covered by _temp_store; reliability.DEFAULT_STORE redirected defensively). (A) PURE GRADIENT: surprise(0.82,False)~0.82 (confident-and-wrong) and surprise(0.11,True)~0.89 (doubtful-and-right) are HIGH, surprise(0.90,True)~0.10 is LOW; competition priors normalise to sum 1 and the adjudication reweight strengthens supported / weakens contradicted / renormalises. (B) FORM grounds COMPETING hypotheses: a Day-1 'my manager just changed' turn yields >=3 HYPOTHESIS records (manager_change/recent_move/family_visit) each carrying the exact turn as evidence, a COMPETITION led by manager_change, and a leading-hypothesis sleep_decline PREDICTION (horizon 14d, status OPEN, internal_only). (C) GROUNDED/CONSERVATIVE: a vague/mood-only/empty turn forms NOTHING. (D) LOOP CLOSES: a Day-14 'I've barely slept' outcome resolves the open prediction -> exactly one LEARNING with prediction_correct=True, an OUTCOME record, surprise~0.33, and the competition ADJUDICATED (manager_change strengthened, recent_move weakened, weights still sum ~1). (E) HIGH-SURPRISE REVISION: a confident prediction proven FALSE ('sleeping great') is high-surprise and appends a MAJOR model REVISION (before_weights->after_weights), counted by calibrate.revisions. (F) CALIBRATE: 1 resolved / 1 correct -> accuracy 1.0 with Brier + mean-surprise, and one data point is NOT yet a reliability verdict. (G) RESTART-SURVIVAL: a fresh records()/loop() read off disk re-derives the closed loop (append-only durable ledger). (H) INTERNAL-ONLY WALL: every formed record is internal_only=True, render() declares INTERNAL model-state / never spoken and trips no banned diagnosis/forecast term, and a forecast-creep phrase is caught by the clean-gate. Real .anima byte-identical before/after. scripts/certify_reality_learning.py is the executable form.

known_gaps: INTERNAL-ONLY BY LAW (not a wallpaper gap): reality.py is imported by NOTHING in the live reply path (mouth/server/route) — server.py only reserves a 'reality_learning' MRI slot ('built at sleep / on demand — not per-turn'). It is a SHADOW/OFFLINE system that accrues a ledger and is surfaced via the read-only scripts/reality.py observatory, never asserted to the user. So this certifies the deterministic backend + durable ledger + internal gate + restart-survival; there is no user-facing live-reply wire to prove (and by design must not be one until the deliberately-unwired LIVE-HOOK is attached).

TIME-GATED accuracy: real calibration accrues only as real OUTCOMES arrive over real calendar time. The full machinery — competition, adjudication, surprise, revision, calibration — is proven here deterministically on a synthetic Day-1 -> Day-14 time-series through the REAL form/resolve engine; LIVE per-category reliability fills in on its own.
